programs.title: English Tuition (CBE & 8-4-4)
programs.summary: Small-group English tuition that builds reading, grammar and composition skills for school learners.
programs.description: Our English tuition follows the CBE and 8-4-4 curricula. Learners get structured lessons in reading comprehension, grammar, composition and oral skills, plus regular practice papers and feedback to parents.
highlights: Composition and oral practice every week

programs.title: CBE & 8-4-4 Subject Tuition
programs.summary: Help with core subjects, homework and exam preparation for CBE and 8-4-4 learners.
programs.description: Focused tuition in Mathematics, Science, Kiswahili and Social Studies. Tutors follow the school timetable, support projects and assignments, and prepare candidates for national assessments.

programs.title: Spoken English Coaching for Adults
programs.summary: Confident everyday and professional English for adults and international learners.
programs.description: Practical coaching in conversation, pronunciation, listening and workplace English. Available in person in Ngong or online for international learners, with lessons tailored to your level and goals.
programs.audience: Adults and international learners (beginner to advanced)
programs.schedule: Tue & Thu 6:00–7:30 p.m. (in person or online)

programs.title: Digital Marketing for Youth & Small Businesses
programs.summary: Learn to grow a brand online: social media, content planning, WhatsApp Business and simple ads.
programs.description: A hands-on course for young people and small business owners. You will plan content, run social media pages, set up WhatsApp Business and Google Business Profile, and launch and measure a small ad campaign.
levels: I already post for my business
highlights: Practise on your own business page

programs.title: Photography Basics
programs.summary: Take better photos with a phone or camera: light, composition and simple editing.
programs.description: From smartphone to DSLR, learn how light, framing and composition work, then edit your photos for social media and clients. Includes a guided photo walk around Ngong.
programs.audience: Youth (14+), creatives and small business owners
programs.schedule: Wednesdays 5:00–7:00 p.m. + one Saturday photo walk

programs.title: Video Production & Editing
programs.summary: Plan, shoot and edit short videos for social media, events and clients.
programs.description: Learn storytelling, shooting on a phone or camera, recording clear audio, and editing in CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Finish with a short film or promo for a real local business.
programs.audience: Youth (16+), content creators and small businesses

programs.title: Ngong Hills Hiking Club
programs.summary: Monthly guided hikes that bring people together and explore the hills on our doorstep.
programs.description: Join a friendly group for guided hikes on the Ngong Hills and nearby trails. Each hike includes a safety briefing, local history and stories along the way, and time to connect over tea afterwards.
programs.audience: Community members, families with teens (13+) and visitors
programs.schedule: First Saturday of each month, 6:30 a.m. start

programs.title: Photo Walks & Storytelling Group
programs.summary: A creative interest group that walks, shoots and tells the stories of Ngong.
programs.description: Meet other creatives, practise photography and short-form storytelling, and help document local people, places and heritage. Open to all skill levels.
programs.audience: Creatives, students and anyone who loves stories
programs.schedule: Second Saturday of each month, 8:00–11:00 a.m.

programs.title: Coworking Office Workspace
programs.summary: A quiet, connected workspace in Ngong with a reading space, meeting space, Wi-Fi and teas & coffees.
programs.description: Work, study or meet clients in a calm space at Kony House. Includes a reading space, a meeting space, 24-hour Wi-Fi access, and teas and coffees.
programs.audience: Students, remote workers, freelancers and small teams
programs.location: Kony House RM: B01, Zambia stage, Ngong

events.title: Raise Smart, Raise Safe: Parenting in the Digital Age
events.description: A free workshop on smart technology use, digital child safeguarding and the parent's role. Facilitated by Dr. John Bosco Kiingati, PhD, Educator & Psychological Expert.

events.title: December Holiday Tuition Intake
events.description: Three weeks of holiday tuition for CBE and 8-4-4 learners: revision, reading and catch-up in a focused, supportive setting.

events.title: Ngong Hills Sunrise Hike
events.description: Catch the sunrise over the Rift Valley on our monthly guided hike. Bring water, good shoes and a light jacket.

events.title: Ngong Town Photo Walk
events.description: Walk, shoot and swap stories with the photo walks group. Phones and cameras welcome.

events.title: January Term Tuition Intake
events.description: New-term intake for English and subject tuition. Come for a short placement chat and timetable planning.

events.title: Digital Skills Open Day
events.description: Free taster sessions in digital marketing, photography and video editing before the new cohorts begin.
